title: 第9章 师徒（求收藏推荐）
content_zh:
张家老屋。
小院中。
李皓到现在还浑身冒汗，后怕不已。
一年的巡检司职业生涯，李皓还是有收获的，若是换成在银城古院时期，李皓未必能如今日这般，面不改色地演了一场戏，瞒天过海。
“赶快找，得马上走人，防止对方杀个回马枪！”
“黑豹！”
李皓视线投向黑豹，对张家老屋他很熟悉，可越是熟悉，往往越是找不到自己需要找的东西。
这次带黑豹来，其实也有借助黑豹的意思。
黑豹仰头看着李皓。
李皓环顾四周，压低了声音，指了指自己胸口的玉剑，“找找看，这里应该还有一件类似于这个的东西，你鼻子灵，搜索一下。”
是的，黑豹也许可以找到。
之前李皓的玉剑，黑豹看到了就很动心。
而且李皓怀疑，黑豹当初流浪到了自己家门口，是不是有可能就是被玉剑给吸引来的？
当然，之前李皓一直没有将玉剑取出来，黑豹没机会去舔。
直到今日，黑豹才抓到了机会。
既然如此，黑豹能闻到石刀的味道吗？
张家一直住在这，李皓觉得，如果石刀真的还在，应该就在屋中，不会被带走，没人会闲着没事干，带着一块石头出门。
黑豹听懂了！
这下子，瞬间来了精神。
至于味道，黑豹没闻到，它也只能靠的极近，才能闻到一点味道。

不知道，也许就错过了。
可既然知道了，黑豹瞬间也上心了，鼻子开始抽动起来，前肢趴伏，鼻子凑在地上，一点点地闻了起来。
李皓要是还找到一件，说不定本狗也能捞点好处呢。
黑豹在用心寻找，李皓也不闲着，开始在院落中寻找起来。
墙角，地面……
这些地方，红影一方肯定也找过，可李皓判断，这些人不知道石刀的样子，说不定压根不知道张家的刀，会是一块石头。
就如李皓，他要是告诉别人，自己胸口佩戴的十字架就是俚曲中的李家的剑，大概也没人会信。
认知上的障碍！
李家的剑，张家的刀，光是听俚曲，恐怕会觉得，这刀剑都是削铁如泥的宝物，不说光芒闪烁，也一定凶悍霸道。
可事实上，李家的剑，只是一枚小小的玉佩，张家的刀，更是不起眼的石头。
十分钟，二十分钟……
李皓有些焦躁，找不到。
是不是没有了？
红影一方是不是找到了，还是说，张家真的给遗失了，不单单他没找到，黑豹闻了一圈，也没有找到。
黑豹靠近的话，应该能闻到一些味道吧？
“没有！”
李皓不能在这一直待着，刚刚吓走了对方，不代表对方不会回来，何况他也不可能一直在这寻找，那迟早会被人发现，自己别有目的。
他站在院落中央，再看看主屋和次卧，思考着，如果自己是张父，会把这石头放在哪？
代入进张父的角色，也许才能判断出来。
“当初，张叔叔压根不在意，就那么随意一丢，后来我再来，也没在意地上有没有那石刀了，但是后来我来张家很多次，好像也没看到，若是还在，这么多年，我总该看到才对。”

“张叔叔十有八九不会珍藏起来，否则当时不会是那个态度，丢的太过随意了。”
他迅速回想当年的一切，尽管记忆有些模糊了。
可此刻再去想，还是隐约能记起来一点。
“小远被揍了一顿，好像有两三天都没出门找我玩，之后，我再来……也许已经过了好几天了，那石刀是不是就在那个期间，被张叔叔拿走了？”
“他拿走一块石头，会做什么？”
“很可能就在那个期间，石刀消失了，否则这么多年，我必然会再次看到的。”
李皓捶了捶自己的脑袋。
那时候太小了，他真的记不清了。
那中间的几天，发生过什么事，或者张叔叔会不会觉得石头碍事，直接就给丢了？
若是真丢了……那就没法找了。
一块石头，十多年了，早就不知道被人清扫到哪去了。
“黑豹都闻不到……是距离太远了，还是嗅觉被干扰了？”
“距离太远，那不用多说，若是嗅觉被干扰……”
李皓陡然眼神一动。
嗅觉被干扰，两个地方可能性最大。
第一，厨房。
第二，茅坑！
这种老屋子，以前小时候是用茅坑的，可不是什么马桶。
当然，最好不要是这样。
“对了……小远家的茅坑和厨房，好像在我小时候都曾修理过，一块石头……不会被填进去了吧？”

李皓想到这，有些猜测，有些不确定。
这是最大的可能了！
如果这两个地方都不在，那就真的没法找了。
“张叔叔揍完小远之后，是先修了厨房，还是先修了茅坑？”
不记得了！
不过此刻，李皓判断，若是石刀还在张家，大概率就在这两处。
不再犹豫，他马上朝厨房走去。
至于茅坑……除非厨房找不到，否则他不会去的，而且石刀若是真在茅坑……以后李皓也不想拿那玩意泡水，给黑豹喝差不多。
反正他有星空剑！
“希望就在厨房！”
“黑豹，跟我来！”
李皓迅速喊了一声，黑豹急忙跟了进来。
厨房很多年没人用了，推门而入，厨房中用的还是一个大锅灶台，上面的铁锅早已生锈，锅盖已经有些腐朽。
“闻闻看！”
李皓指了指灶台：“黑豹，别被味道干扰了！”
厨房多年不用，但是因为使用时间长，还是有一股淡淡的烟火味，这样的味道，也许干扰到了黑豹，其中还夹杂着一些散不去的油烟味。
黑豹在厨房，的确有些晕头转向，主要是厨房中还有一股浓浓的霉味。
之前黑豹也进来闻过，没有什么发现。
这时候听李皓说，黑豹动作敏捷，一下子跳上了灶台，一点点地闻了起来。
很快，鼻子上就染上了一层黑色木灰。

而李皓也没闲着，厨房中，后来修理的地方不用多看，主要是看十几年前修缮的地方，那些地方才有可能用上了石刀。
这样的地方，红影背后的势力都未必愿意多看。
张家的刀，张家人会藏在这地方？
当然，李皓简单看了一圈，发现红影和其背后的势力，恐怕真的相当重视，厨房也有翻动的迹象，甚至连灶台下的灰烬都被搅动过。
沉寂多年的灰烬，不是现在这样子，可能被翻动过。
“果然，对方也在找，连炉膛都不放过，相当尽心了！”
张家的传家宝，会藏在灰烬中吗？
换成李皓，恐怕都觉得不会，对方还是搜索了，可见还是相当严谨的。
等待了一会，黑豹还是无所获。
李皓有些失望，难道真的在茅坑吗？
那也太恶心了！
正想着，李皓眼神微动，忽然看向灶台上的那个大烟囱，这种老屋的厨房，都是配备一根砖砌的烟囱的，要是没烟囱，那厨房烧饭的时候没法待。
“嗯……烟囱？”
李皓忽然想起了什么，这烟囱，是不是就是那次张叔叔揍完小远后修建的？
他隐约好像有些印象！
黑豹不算大，个头不高，一直在灶台上闻，却是爬不上一人高的烟囱上。
“难道在这？”
李皓瞬间动了，动作敏捷，一下子跳上灶台，一手抓起黑豹，低声道：“闻一闻！”
他提着黑豹，将黑豹当探测器来用。
而黑豹，两只狗眼中满是无奈。

鼻子抽动，一路随着李皓的手臂往上闻。
沿着灶台向上一米多，忽然，黑豹鼻子抽动了一下，一股有些熟悉的味道，渐渐地弥漫在鼻尖。
“汪汪！”
黑豹眼神忽然亮了。
而李皓，也是眼神雪亮！
发现了？
真的在这！
烟囱……这恐怕也是红影背后势力想不到的，谁会想到，张家会把祖传的刀，给砌进了烟囱里。
他们甚至可能沿着烟囱找过！
或者红影干脆探查过，红影无形无质，李皓不知道对方能否穿墙遁地，可对方对墙壁和地面应该都搜索过，可他们的目标，可能是什么夹缝、夹层、箱子、宝盒之类的。
他们不会想到，被他们在意的刀，只是一块石头。
李皓眼神发亮，盯着烟囱上的一块凸起一点点的地方看，石刀在这上面吗？
斑驳的石灰墙壁，已经脱落。
露出了烟囱里面的一些砖块。
李皓伸手摸了摸，一些石灰外墙再次脱落下来，下一刻，烟囱上显露出一块土灰色的石头，没有完全露出来，但是看到那不完整的外形，李皓眼神彻底亮了！
“就是这个！”
李皓心脏跳动，就是这个，虽然没完全露出来，可李皓记忆中已经浮现出隐约的样子，如同一把刀的石头，不算太大，也就比拳头大一点。
“张叔叔……还真是尊重先祖！”
李皓忽然有些哭笑不得，当初为了这块石头，揍了自己儿子一顿。
好家伙，转头家里修厨房，就把老祖宗留下来的石头给砌进去了，就没你这么尊重老祖宗的！

你张家的老祖宗要是还活着，大概也能气死。
八大家中，李皓不知道其他人如何，反正李家的剑，是一直当传家宝传承下来的，张家这块石头能传下来，李皓觉得简直太不容易了！
也许，当年不是石头的样子？
只是后来渐渐石化了，到了张父这一代，彻底变成了石头？
来不及去想，也没心思去想，李皓看着眼前嵌入烟囱的石头，微微凝眉。
找到了！
但是，不好取啊！
不是不能取，关键是，取走了这石刀，烟囱上的痕迹很明显。
在巡检司待了一年，李皓还是有经验的，你一旦动了这地方，红影和背后的人回来了，肯定是要查看一下，看看李皓的目的是什么的。
烟囱上少了一块石头，也许对方很快就能反应过来！
如果李皓还是当时古院的学员，此刻，他会第一时间取走石刀，那时候红影回来了，大概会第一时间想到，张家的刀，可能就是这块被取走的石头，然后李皓就麻烦大了！
到了那时候，红影就能知晓，石刀在李皓手中，没事也会给自己招惹一堆麻烦。
甚至还能判断出，李皓已经猜到了什么，甚至知晓八大家的事，一下子就能把老底全部给透露出去！
“怎么办？”
李皓迅速思考，既然看到了，那也不能不管，就把石刀放在这，他觉得张家的刀不但是宝物，而且一定还有其他作用。
红影一方很重视，否则不可能一年后还冒着危险，一直在这监视。
李皓皱眉，取走石刀，再用一块石头填补进来？
可对方查到了，反而此地无银三百两了！
新旧痕迹，还是不一样的。
“只能彻底的毁尸灭迹，销毁证据，让对方无从查起，最好的办法自然是毁掉烟囱……可那会不会太刻意了？”

“找一块同样的石头，最好是差不多模样的石头……然后摧毁烟囱，事后哪怕对方重新还原，也不会少一块石头，从而被发现什么……”
作为一名巡检，李皓的基础职业技能还是掌握的，如何毁灭证据，如何制造假证据，迷惑对方，这都是他一年来学到的，看到的。
若是单纯的摧毁，红影一方事后暗中还原，那也有可能还原出原本的烟囱模样，发现少了一块石头。
确定了自己要做什么，李皓没有马上取走石刀。
在这放了多年，都没人在意，不急于一时。
想到这，李皓轻轻吐了口气，找到就行，再等片刻，不过这次还得麻烦一下老师才行。
从厨房走出，李皓直接拨通了老师的通讯。
很快，几乎是打过去的瞬间，袁硕的声音就传来了：“没事吧？”
“老师，没事！”
李皓带着一些感激，没有多寒暄什么，很快道：“老师，张远的家里倒是没什么发现，可是我发现，好像有人在一直盯着张远家这边，而且张远家好像被人翻动过，您说是不是凶手要来寻找什么？”
袁硕听话知其意，若有所思道：“那你的想法是什么？”
“我在想，能不能引蛇出洞？”
李皓很快道：“既然对方来了张远家，还要找什么，是不是没找到？不过我人微言轻，在巡检司说不上话，要不劳烦老师，让巡检司派人来一趟，动静大一点，拆掉一些张家的建筑，打草惊蛇，看看能不能引出杀张远的凶手。”
有这个必要吗？
当然，张远家并非案发现场，而且这一块早就开始拆迁了，真拆了也没什么。
袁硕只是猜测，李皓是不是发现了什么？
所以想通过这种手段来得到什么，或者真的可以引出背后的东西？
而这时候的李皓，也清楚一点，拆家，很可能引起红影一方的注意，但是没关系，越是大张旗鼓越好，巡检司有内鬼那就更好。
将情况事无巨细地告诉对方，那就更符合李皓的心意了。
他只需要做一件事，用一块同样的石头，替换掉石刀，哪怕事后对方还原一切，也没什么。

红影一方，那时候只会猜测，是不是李皓察觉到了什么，而不会确定李皓真的取走了什么。
顶多认为李皓推理能力强，发现了一些蛛丝马迹。
而李皓要做的，就是让对方怀疑，但是不确定，拖延时间，将事情渐渐闹大，从而引出巡夜人更好。
“将黑暗的事情，公布于大众视线之中……无论是巡夜人还是红影，好像都不太愿意在大众面前出现，也不愿意将事情闹的沸沸扬扬！”
“而我，作为一位普通人，我需要更多的关注度，也能将我自己摘出去，给双方留下我是个聪明人，但是的确不知内情的普通人的印象！”
“为了给好友报仇，我选择将事情闹大……引起更大的关注度，也符合我的身份！”
“……”
权衡利弊，最终李皓有了这样的决定和选择。
说不定这样一来，可以提前引起巡夜人关注，甚至可以近距离接触，李皓甚至可以向上面汇报，他发现了一些蛛丝马迹，比如之前在外盯梢的人。
至于红影，他自然是没发现的，可外面的是人！
李皓甚至在外墙上发现了一个脚印，这就是最好的证据，对方显然没有太在意自己留下脚印的事。
脑筋迅速转动，确定好了可能引发的后果，李皓还是选择了将事情稍微放大化。
而通讯对面，袁硕问了几句，确定了自己这个学生的选择。
袁硕知道，李皓很聪明，不会无缘无故地要这么做。
既然如此，不是大事，那就支持一些好了。
“好，我马上给巡检司那边致电！而且张远是古院学员，若是真的是凶杀案，古院也不会放任不管！你先撤离那边，最多一个小时，古院会派人过去，巡检司也会过去……”
“谢谢老师！”
李皓连忙道谢，自己这老师，有时候还是很够意思的。
也正因为如此，李皓更不愿意将红影的事情说给老师听。
再有权威，袁硕也只是普通人。

李皓不希望把老师卷入其中。
“客气什么！”
袁硕倒是不太在意这个，又说了几句，选择了挂断通讯。
银城古院。
古院深处，一处古典大宅院中，袁硕七十多岁了，依旧精神饱满，眼神犀利。
身体也相当健硕，看起来更像是军人，而非银城顶级的大教授。
此刻，袁硕面前也放着一份档案。
关于六起自焚案的档案！
“巡检司……还真是筛子！”
袁硕挂断了通讯，揉了揉太阳穴，低声骂了一句，巡检司这些年，越来越不中用了，这么容易就把这案卷给泄露了出去，现在有心想关注的话，银城很多人都能拿到这份档案。
“我这学生……还真不省心，这事也敢暗中追查，这就算了，居然还敢直接上报给巡检司，一看就知道不寻常！”
轻叹一声，年轻人啊，真没经验，巡检司是个大筛子，你不知道吗？
这案卷一出，明眼人其实都能看出一些问题所在。
“李家的剑，张家的刀，赵家的拳，刘家的腿……”
哼了一会银城俚曲，袁硕迅速判断了一阵，这其中，是否也和自己这个学生有些关联？
“死了六个，不知道是不是和这曲子有关。”
作为老银城人，他知道这曲子，而且他是知名的学者，当看到档案的瞬间，他其实就联系到了这首曲子，因为这些姓，加在一起有些特殊。
判断了一阵，袁硕拿出了通讯，迅速拨通了一个号码。
等待了一阵，袁硕语气威严，甚至带着一些愤怒：“我是袁硕！别和我废话，我的学生如今处于危险之中，古院一年前发生的自焚案，可能是他杀，你们巡检司一点信息都没有吗？”
“……”

“我不管那些，李皓是我的学生，他刚入古院，就进入我门下，你知道为什么吗？他是天才，顶级的探索家，古文明探索系的未来，为了你们的失职，他不得不退出古院，你们给古院造成了多大的损失？”
“……”
“李皓现在有所发现，可你们巡检司如同筛子，一下子就把他暴露了，他现在处于危险之中，可能随时会死！现在他在古院死亡学员张远家中，我不管如何，你们就是荡平了那条街道，也得把李皓救出来，把暗中的鬼魅魍魉给我一网打尽！”
“……”
“少废话，你必须马上派人过去，我不管动静大不大，马上包围那条街道，一点点给我推进，包围暗中可能存在的凶手，我就一个要求，李皓必须完好无损地回来！”
“……”
“就这样，你要是做不到，我就直接去找巡夜人来处理！六起自焚案，你以为我袁硕眼睛瞎了，看不出其中可能存在的问题？你银城巡检司不希望巡夜人介入，可我的学生死了，我闹到上面，也得将你们银城巡检司扒层皮下来！”
“袁老息怒，马上处理，袁老放心！”
通讯对面，银城巡检司的司长，有些头疼。
这老家伙，虽说没什么实权，可认识的人是真多，在古院当了四五十年的教授，带出来的学员，有些如今也是大人物了。
真闹大了，银城巡检司也得难受。
“放心个屁，古院也会去人，实在不行我亲自过去！我倒想看看，在银城这地界，到底谁那么大胆子，敢杀我古院学员！杀了一个还不够，连我袁硕的关门弟子都要动，吃了熊心豹子胆吗？”
袁硕如同暴怒的猛虎。
李皓既然想闹大点，好像是为了引出一些东西……那就闹大点好了！
袁硕不嫌事大！
真闹大了……真有麻烦，那也是别人的麻烦。
至于自己，现在各方都需要自己，不会对自己如何的，至于李皓，那也简单，给这家伙一个助理的身份，那些人不敢动自己，自然也不会动李皓。
挂断了通讯，袁硕没了刚刚的愤怒，只是看向屋外，轻轻叹息一声。
小子，普通人，还是不要参与进去了。
张远的事，就算真有什么问题，现在你做的也够了，不能再参与其中了。

“可惜啊！”
一声低不可闻的遗憾之语，从口中缓缓传出。
可惜，我无法真正去引入神秘，否则……哪有这么麻烦。
我若是能引入神秘能，以我的五禽新书造诣，也许可以一日三升，那时候，什么鬼魅魍魉都是虚妄！
“哼！”
一声低哼再次传出，巡夜人那边，也未必希望自己进入神秘领域，否则，我还何必和他们合作？
这些年，一直说想办法，却是一点办法都没有，真当自己傻？
“李皓……”
“李家的剑？”
喃喃一声，袁硕闭目，不再去想，那家伙还是老老实实回古院给我当助理算了，一把年纪了，他也的确需要培养一位接班人了。

Zhang family's old house.
In the small courtyard.
Li Hao is still sweating and terrified.
Li Hao has gained something from his one-year career in the Inspection Department. If it were during his time at the Yincheng Ancient Courtyard, Li Hao might not be able to act like he is today, keeping a straight face and concealing the truth.
"Look for me quickly, we have to leave immediately to prevent the other party from retaliate!"
"Black Panther!"
Li Hao turned his attention to Black Panther. He was very familiar with the Zhang family's old house, but the more familiar he became, the harder he often found what he needed to find.
Bringing the black panther this time actually means using the black panther.
Black Panther looked up at Li Hao.
Li Hao looked around, lowered his voice, and pointed to the jade sword on his chest, "Have a look. There should be something similar to this here. If you have a good nose, search for it."
Yes, Black Panther may be found.
Black Panther was very attracted to Li Hao's jade sword when he saw it.
Moreover, Li Hao wondered if the Black Panther might have been attracted by the jade sword when he wandered to his doorstep?
Of course, Li Hao had never taken out the jade sword before, so Black Panther had no chance to lick it.
It wasn't until today that the Black Panthers got their chance.
That being the case, can Black Panther smell the stone knife?
The Zhang family has always lived here. Li Hao felt that if the stone knife was really still there, it would be in the house and would not be taken away. No one would go out with nothing to do but a stone.
Black Panther got it!
Now, I felt energetic instantly.
As for the smell, the black panther didn't smell it, and it could only smell something if it got very close.
I don’t know, maybe I missed it.
But now that he knew it, the black panther was instantly interested. His nose began to twitch, his forelimbs lay down, his nose was on the ground, and he smelled bit by bit.
If Li Hao finds another one, maybe this dog can also benefit from it.
Black Panther was searching hard, and Li Hao was not idle either, and began to search in the courtyard.
Corner, floor...
Hongying's party must have looked for these places, but Li Hao judged that these people didn't know what a stone knife looked like, and maybe they didn't even know that the Zhang family's knife was a stone.
Just like Li Hao, if he told others that the cross he wore on his chest was the sword of the Li family in the slang, probably no one would believe it.
Cognitive barriers!
The swords of the Li family and the swords of the Zhang family. Just listening to the slang, I am afraid that these swords are treasures that can be sharpened like clay. Not to mention the shining light, they must be fierce and domineering.
But in fact, the Li family's sword is just a small jade pendant, and the Zhang family's sword is an inconspicuous stone.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes...
Li Hao was a little anxious and couldn't find it.
Is it gone?
Did Hong Ying find it, or did the Zhang family really lose it? Not only did he not find it, but Black Panther sniffed around and couldn't find it either.
If the black panther is close, you should be able to smell something, right?
"No!"
Li Hao can't stay here forever. Just because he scared the other party away doesn't mean that the other party won't come back. Besides, he can't keep searching here. Sooner or later, someone will discover that he has ulterior motives.
He stood in the center of the courtyard, looked at the main room and the second bedroom, and thought, if he were Zhang's father, where would he put this stone?
Perhaps only by assuming the role of Zhang's father can we judge.
"At first, Uncle Zhang didn't care at all and just threw it away casually. Later, when I came back, I didn't care whether there was that stone knife on the ground. But then I came to Zhang's house many times and didn't seem to see it. If it was still there, after so many years, I should have seen it."
"Uncle Zhang most likely wouldn't have kept it, otherwise he wouldn't have had that attitude at the time and it would have been too casual to throw it away."
He quickly recalled everything that happened back then, although his memory was a little blurry.
But now that I think about it, I can still vaguely remember it.
"Xiaoyuan was beaten up, and it seemed that he didn't go out to play with me for two or three days. After that, when I came back...Several days have passed. Was the stone knife taken away by Uncle Zhang during that period? "
“What would he do if he took away a stone? "
"It is very likely that the stone knife disappeared during that period, otherwise I would definitely see it again after so many years. "
Li Hao slapped his head.
He was so young at that time that he really can't remember it.
What happened in the intervening days? Or did Uncle Zhang think the stone was in the way and just threw it away?
If it's really lost...then there's no way to find it.
A piece of stone has been swept away for more than ten years. I don’t know where it has been swept away.
“The black panther can’t even smell it… Is it too far away, or is the sense of smell disturbed? "
"The distance is too far, so needless to say, if the sense of smell is disturbed..."
Li Hao's eyes suddenly moved.
There are two places where the sense of smell is most likely to be disturbed.
First, the kitchen.
Second, the pit!
This kind of old house used to have a latrine when I was a kid, not a toilet.
Of course, it's best not to be like this.
"By the way...it seems that the pit and kitchen of Xiaoyuan's house were repaired when I was a child. A stone...couldn't have been filled in, right? "
When Li Hao thought about this, he had some guesses and some uncertainties.
This is the greatest possibility!
If these two places are not available, then there is really no way to find it.
"After Uncle Zhang beat Xiao Yuan, did he repair the kitchen first or the latrine first? "
Don’t remember!
But at this moment, Li Hao judged that if the stone knife was still in the Zhang family, it would most likely be in these two places.
Without hesitation, he immediately walked towards the kitchen.
As for the latrine... Unless he couldn't find it in the kitchen, he wouldn't go there. And if the stone knife was really in the latrine... Li Hao wouldn't want to soak that thing in water in the future, it would be more like giving it to the black panther.
He has the Starry Sky Sword anyway!
“Hope is in the kitchen! "
“Black Panther, follow me! "
Li Hao shouted quickly, and Black Panther hurriedly followed.
The kitchen had not been used for many years. When I pushed the door open, I saw that there was still a large pot on the stove. The iron pot on it had long been rusty and the lid of the pot was somewhat rotten.
“Smell and see! "
Li Hao pointed to the stove: "Black Panther, don't be disturbed by the smell! "
The kitchen has not been used for many years, but due to long use, there is still a faint smell of fireworks. This smell may have disturbed the Black Panther, and it is also mixed with some lingering oil smoke smell.
Black Panther was indeed a little dizzy in the kitchen, mainly because there was a strong musty smell in the kitchen.
The black panther came in and smelled it before, but found nothing.
At this time, Li Hao said that the black panther moved quickly and jumped on the stove, smelling it bit by bit.
Soon, the nose was stained with a layer of black wood ash.
And Li Hao was not idle either. In the kitchen, there was no need to look at the places that had been repaired later. The main thing was to look at the places that had been repaired more than ten years ago. Stone knives were probably used in those places.
In such a place, the forces behind Hongying may not be willing to take a closer look.
This is where the Zhang family would hide the Zhang family's knife?
Of course, Li Hao took a brief look around and found that Hong Ying and the forces behind him probably really took it seriously. There were signs of stirring in the kitchen, and even the ashes under the stove had been stirred.
The ashes that have been lying dormant for many years may have been turned over instead of what they are now.
"Sure enough, the other party is also looking for it, even the furnace is not spared, he is quite dedicated! "
Will the Zhang family heirloom be hidden in the ashes?
If it were Li Hao, he probably wouldn't think so, but the other party still searched, which shows that he was quite rigorous.
After waiting for a while, Black Panther still found nothing.
Li Hao was a little disappointed. Was he really in a pit?
That's too disgusting!
Just as he was thinking about it, Li Hao's eyes moved slightly and suddenly he looked at the big chimney on the stove. The kitchens in old houses like this are all equipped with a brick chimney. Without a chimney, there would be no way to cook in the kitchen.
“Um…chimney? "
plumHao suddenly remembered something. Was this chimney built after Uncle Zhang beat Xiao Yuan that time?
He seemed to have some vague impression!
The black panther is not big and tall. It is always smelling on the stove, but it cannot climb up the chimney that is as tall as a person.
"Is it here?"
Li Hao moved instantly, and with quick movements, he jumped onto the stove, grabbed the black panther with one hand, and whispered: "Smell it!"
He carried the panther and used it as a detector.
As for the black panther, the eyes of the two dogs were full of helplessness.
His nose twitched and he smelled all the way up Li Hao's arm.
More than a meter up the stove, Black Panther's nose suddenly twitched, and a somewhat familiar smell gradually filled the tip of his nose.
"Woof woof!"
Black Panther's eyes suddenly lit up.
And Li Hao also has sharp eyes!
Found it?
Really here!
Chimney... This is probably something that the forces behind Hong Ying could not have imagined. Who would have thought that the Zhang family would build their ancestral sword into the chimney.
They may have even searched along the chimney!
Or maybe Hong Ying had simply investigated. Hong Ying was intangible and had no quality. Li Hao didn't know if the other party could escape through the wall, but the other party should have searched the walls and the ground, but their target might be some kind of crack, mezzanine, box, treasure box or the like.
They don't think that the knife they care about is just a stone.
Li Hao's eyes were bright and he stared at a slightly raised spot on the chimney. Is the stone knife on it?
The mottled plaster walls have fallen off.
Some of the bricks inside the chimney are exposed.
Li Hao reached out and touched it, and some of the lime exterior walls fell off again. The next moment, a piece of earthy gray stone was revealed on the chimney. It was not completely exposed, but when he saw the incomplete shape, Li Hao's eyes completely lit up!
"That's it!"
Li Hao's heart was beating. This was it. Although it was not completely exposed, Li Hao's memory already had a vague image of it. It was like a stone like a knife. It was not too big, just a little bigger than a fist.
"Uncle Zhang... you really respect your ancestors!"
Li Hao suddenly felt dumbfounded. He had beaten his son for this stone.
Good guy, when I renovated the kitchen at home, I built in the stones left by my ancestors. You don’t respect your ancestors as much as you do!
If your Zhang family ancestors were still alive, they would probably be angry to death.
Among the eight families, Li Hao didn't know about the others. Anyway, the Li family's sword has been passed down as a family heirloom. Li Hao felt that it was really not easy for the Zhang family to pass down this stone!
Maybe it didn't look like stone back then?
But it gradually turned to stone, and by Zhang's generation, it completely turned into stone?
With no time to think, and no inclination to think, Li Hao looked at the stone embedded in the chimney in front of him and frowned slightly.
Found it!
However, it’s not easy to get!
It's not that it can't be taken away. The key point is that after taking away the stone knife, the marks on the chimney are very obvious.
After staying in the Inspection Department for a year, Li Hao still has experience. Once you move this place, Hong Ying and the people behind him come back, and they will definitely check to see what Li Hao's purpose is.
There is a stone missing from the chimney, maybe the other party will react soon!
If Li Hao was still a student of the Ancient Academy at that time, he would have taken away the stone knife as soon as possible. When Hong Ying came back, he would probably have immediately thought that the Zhang family's knife might be the stone that was taken away, and then Li Hao would be in big trouble!
At that time, Hong Ying will know that if the stone knife is in Li Hao's hands, it will cause him a lot of trouble.
He could even tell that Li Hao had already guessed something, and even knew about the Eight Families, so he could reveal all his secrets at once!
"What to do?"
Li Hao thought quickly. Since he saw it, he couldn't ignore it, so he put the stone knife here. He felt that the Zhang family's knife was not only a treasure, but also had other functions.
redYing Yifang attaches great importance to it, otherwise it would not be possible for him to risk his life and keep surveillance here a year later.
Li Hao frowned, took away the stone knife, and filled it with another stone?
But when the other party found out, there was no three hundred taels of silver left!
The old and new traces are still different.
"The only way is to completely destroy the corpse and destroy the evidence so that the other party can't investigate. The best way is to destroy the chimney... But wouldn't that be too deliberate?"
"Find the same stone, preferably a stone with a similar appearance...and then destroy the chimney. Even if the other party restores it afterwards, there will still be no missing stone, and something will be discovered..."
As an inspector, Li Hao has mastered the basic professional skills. How to destroy evidence, how to create false evidence, and confuse the other party. This is what he has learned and seen in the past year.
If it was simply destroyed and the Red Shadow party secretly restored it afterwards, it would be possible to restore the original chimney appearance and find that a stone was missing.
After deciding what he wanted to do, Li Hao did not take away the stone knife immediately.
It has been here for many years, but no one cares about it and is not in a hurry.
Thinking of this, Li Hao breathed out softly, just find it and wait for a while, but this time he has to trouble the teacher.
Walking out of the kitchen, Li Hao directly dialed the teacher's communication.
Soon, almost immediately after the fight, Yuan Shuo's voice came: "Are you okay?"
"Teacher, it's okay!"
With some gratitude, Li Hao said quickly without saying much: "Teacher, I didn't find anything at Zhang Yuan's house, but I found that someone seemed to be staring at Zhang Yuan's house, and Zhang Yuan's house seemed to have been disturbed. Do you think the murderer came to look for something?"
Yuan Shuo listened and understood the meaning, and said thoughtfully: "Then what are your thoughts?"
"I was wondering if I could lure the snake out of its hole?"
Li Hao quickly said: "Since the other party has come to Zhang Yuan's house, what else are they looking for? Didn't they find it? But I am a soft-spoken person and can't talk to the Inspection Department. Why don't I bother the teacher and ask the Inspection Department to send someone to come and make more noise, demolish some Zhang family buildings, alert the snake, and see if we can lead out the murderer of Zhang Yuan."
Is this necessary?
Of course, Zhang Yuan's house was not the scene of the crime, and the demolition of this area had already begun. It would not matter if it was really demolished.
Yuan Shuo was just guessing, did Li Hao discover something?
So what do you want to get through this method, or can it really lead to the things behind it?
At this time, Li Hao also knew that demolishing the house would probably attract the attention of Hongying, but it didn't matter. The more publicity, the better. It would be better if there was an insider in the inspection department.
It would be more in line with Li Hao's wishes to tell the other party the situation in detail.
He only needs to do one thing, replace the stone knife with the same stone. Even if the other party restores everything afterwards, it doesn't matter.
Hong Ying's side would only guess at that time whether Li Hao noticed something, but would not confirm what Li Hao really took away.
At most, it is believed that Li Hao has strong reasoning ability and discovered some clues.
What Li Hao wants to do is to make the other party suspicious but not sure, delaying time, gradually making the matter worse, and thus attracting the night watchman.
"Revealing dark matters into the public eye... Neither the night watchman nor the red shadow seem to be willing to appear in front of the public, nor are they willing to make things a fuss!"
"As for me, as an ordinary person, I need more attention, and I can also remove myself and leave the impression to both parties that I am a smart person, but an ordinary person who really doesn't know what's going on!"
"In order to avenge my friend, I chose to make the matter bigger... to attract greater attention, which is also in line with my identity!"
"..."
After weighing the pros and cons, Li Hao finally made this decision and choice.
Maybe in this way, we can attract the attention of the night watchman in advance, or evenEven with close contact, Li Hao could even report to the superiors that he found some clues, such as the people who were being watched outside before.
As for Hong Ying, he naturally didn't notice it, but there was a person outside!
Li Hao even found a footprint on the outer wall. This is the best evidence. The other party obviously didn't pay much attention to the footprints he left.
After thinking quickly and determining the possible consequences, Li Hao chose to amplify the matter a little.
On the other side of the communication, Yuan Shuo asked a few questions to confirm his choice as a student.
Yuan Shuo knew that Li Hao was very smart and would not do this for no reason.
Since this is not a big deal, then just support some.
"Okay, I'll call the Inspection Department immediately! And Zhang Yuan is a student of the Ancient Academy. If it is really a murder, the Ancient Academy will not let it go! You evacuate there first. In an hour at most, the Ancient Academy will send someone there, and the Inspection Department will also go there..."
"Thank you teacher!"
Li Hao quickly thanked him. He is a very interesting teacher sometimes.
Because of this, Li Hao was even more reluctant to tell the teacher about Hong Ying.
No matter how authoritative he is, Yuan Shuo is just an ordinary person.
Li Hao did not want to involve the teacher.
"Why are you so polite!"
Yuan Shuo didn't care much about this, he said a few more words and chose to hang up the communication.
Yincheng Ancient Courtyard.
Deep in the ancient courtyard, in a large classical mansion, Yuan Shuo is over seventy years old, still full of energy and sharp eyes.
His body is also quite strong, and he looks more like a soldier than a top professor in Silver City.
At this moment, Yuan Shuo also had a file in front of him.
Files on six self-immolations!
"The Inspection Department...is really a sieve!"
Yuan Shuo hung up the call, rubbed his temples, and cursed in a low voice. The Inspection Department has become increasingly useless in recent years. It was so easy to leak this case file. If you want to pay attention to it now, many people in Yincheng can get this file.
"My student... is really careless. I dare to investigate this matter secretly. Forget it, I dare to report it directly to the Inspection Department. I can tell it's unusual at a glance!"
Sighing softly, young man, you are really inexperienced. The Inspection Department is a big sieve, don’t you know?
As soon as this case file comes out, anyone with a discerning eye can actually see some problems.
"The Li family's sword, the Zhang family's knife, the Zhao family's fists, the Liu family's legs..."
After humming Yincheng slang for a while, Yuan Shuo quickly made a judgment. Is there any connection between this and his student?
"Six people died. I don't know if it's related to this song."
As an old Yincheng native, he knew this tune, and he was a well-known scholar. When he saw the file, he actually connected it with this tune, because these surnames together were somewhat special.
After judging for a while, Yuan Shuo took out the communication and quickly dialed a number.
After waiting for a while, Yuan Shuo spoke in a majestic tone, even with some anger: "I am Yuan Shuo! Don't talk nonsense to me. My students are in danger now. The self-immolation case that occurred in Guyuan a year ago may have been a homicide. Don't you, the Inspection Department, have any information?"
"..."
"I don't care about that. Li Hao is my student. He entered my school as soon as he entered the Ancient Academy. Do you know why? He is a genius, a top explorer, and the future of the Department of Ancient Civilization Exploration. Because of your negligence, he had to withdraw from the Ancient Academy. How much loss have you caused to the Ancient Academy?"
"..."
"Li Hao has discovered something now, but your inspection department is like a sieve, exposing him all at once. He is now in danger and may die at any time! Now he is at the home of Zhang Yuan, the deceased student in the ancient courtyard. I don't care what happens. Even if you clear that street, you still have to rescue Li Hao and catch all the ghosts and monsters in the dark!"
"..."
"Stop talking nonsense, you must send someone over immediately, I don't care if the movement is big or not,Immediately surround that street, push me forward bit by bit, and surround the possible murderer in the dark. I have only one request, Li Hao must come back intact! "
"..."
"That's it, if you can't do it, I'll go directly to the night watchman to deal with it! There have been six self-immolations. Do you think I, Yuan Shuo, am blind and cannot see the possible problems in them? Your Yincheng Inspection Department doesn't want the night watchmen to get involved, but my student is dead, and if I cause trouble to the higher-ups, I'll have to strip you Yincheng Inspection Department down! "
"Mr. Yuan, calm down and deal with it immediately. Don't worry, Mr. Yuan! "
On the other side of the communication line, the director of the Yincheng Inspection Department had a headache.
Although this old guy has no real power, he knows a lot of people. He has been a professor in the ancient academy for forty or fifty years, and some of the students he has brought out are now big shots.
If the commotion is really big, the Yincheng Inspection Department will also feel uncomfortable.
"Don't worry, there will be people in the ancient courtyard. If that doesn't work, I'll go there myself! I would like to see who in this world of Yincheng is so bold as to kill my students from the Ancient Academy! It's not enough to kill one, but you have to kill even my closed disciples, Yuan Shuo. Are you going to eat the heart of a bear and the courage of a leopard? "
Yuan Shuo was like a furious tiger.
Since Li Hao wants to make a big fuss, it seems to be to elicit something... then he should make a big fuss!
Yuan Shuo doesn’t think it’s a big deal!
If there is really a big fuss...if there is really trouble, it is also other people's trouble.
As for himself, all parties need him now and will not do anything to him. As for Li Hao, it is simple. Give this guy the status of an assistant. If those people dare not touch him, they will naturally not touch Li Hao.
After hanging up the call, Yuan Shuo lost his anger just now and just looked outside the room and sighed softly.
Boy, ordinary people, it’s better not to get involved.
Regarding Zhang Yuan's matter, even if there is any problem, you have done enough now and can no longer get involved.
"What a pity! "
An inaudible word of regret came slowly from his mouth.
It's a pity that I can't really introduce mystery, otherwise...it wouldn't be so troublesome.
If I could introduce mystical energy, and with my attainments in the Five Animals New Book, I might be able to produce it three times a day. At that time, all ghosts and monsters would be false!
"Hmph! "
A low hum came out again. The night watchmen may not want to enter the mysterious realm. Otherwise, why should I cooperate with them?
Over the years, I have been talking about finding a way, but there is no way at all. Do you really think you are stupid?
"Li Hao..."
“The Li family’s sword? "
With a murmur, Yuan Shuo closed his eyes and stopped thinking about it. That guy should just go back to the ancient courtyard and be my assistant. Now that he is old, he really needs to train a successor.
